editorial:
Imagine a guy who spends his days tending to beautiful flowers and his nights taking out targets for a living. You get to follow this quiet gardener who is actually a world-class killer, trying his best to stay under the radar. Things get messy when he meets someone who saw some dirty cops in action. Instead of doing his job, he actually starts to like this person, which puts his secret life in danger. It feels like a mix of a cozy neighborhood story and a high-stakes spy game, keeping you on your toes about who is actually the good guy here.

What really works is how the action feels punchy and real without being too over the top. The chemistry between the leads is great, though some of the middle parts drag a bit. If you love movies where a hidden expert has to protect someone, you will love this. You should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the cool detail in the fight scenes. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a smart move for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, the gardener discovers that his own boss was working with the corrupt police. He uses his knowledge of the city's parks to trap the villains in a huge greenhouse. After a big fight, he takes down the lead cop and his handler. He decides to leave his assassin life behind for good and helps the witness disappear to a safe place, finally finding peace as a real florist.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves secret agent stories and fast action.
